title: Sanger Sequencing for Genes Causing Intellectual Disability
author: Megan McSherry
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tzxep7n
materials: The DNA concentration per sample is 20 ng/μL
on top of the black mold plate
For optimal results sequence immediately or asap

1. Add dry Sephadex G-50 (VWR cat. 95016-896) to Millipore (cat. #MACL09645) 45 ul column loader (black mold plate) 2. Place a Pall Corportation multi-well plate (VWR cat. 97052-098) on top of the black mold plate 3. Carefully turn both plates over and tap the mold plate causing Sephadex to fall into wells 4. Add 300 ul of dH2O to each well 5. Cover plate with adhesive seal (Applied Biosystems cat. 4306311). Write date on plate 6. Allow plates to hydrate for 2 hours before use. Plates can stand in room temperature for 2 days. Can be stored at 4°C for two weeks (if stored at 4°C the plate must incubate at room temperature for 2 hours before use)

steps.title: Plan Reaction Quantities
steps.instruction: Calculate the number of reactions to be performed for each assay, including recommended positive and negative controls, preparing excess volume to account for pipetting errors.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Products for Purification
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR products for Sephadex purification.

substeps.instruction: Remove plate from PCR machine/Thermal Cycler and cover with aluminum foil
Bring Sephadex plate to room temperature and remove adhesive seal
Place Sephadex plate on top of a 96-well waste plate
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 850 x g and dispose of the eluate

steps.title: Wash Sephadex Columns
steps.instruction: Wash the columns using distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 ul dH20 to each well
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 850 x g and dispose of eluate

steps.title: Purify PCR Products
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR products using SOPE resin and Sephadex columns.

substeps.instruction: Bring PCR products to a volume of 20 ul
Add 4 ul of SOPE resin directly to the PCR product and mix thoroughly by tip mixing
Pipette 10 ul of dH2O directly into sequencing reactions
Pipette the entire SOPE/PCR reaction mixture (approximately 20 ul) into the center of the Sephadex plate wells, ensuring fluid runs into the column without touching the column

steps.title: Collect Purified Eluate
steps.instruction: Collect the purified product into a sequencing plate.

substeps.instruction: Stack the loaded Sephadex plate on top of a 96-well ABI sequencing plate (cat. 4346907)
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 850 x g
Retain the eluate and dispose of the Sephadex plate

steps.title: Prepare Plate for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Finalize the plate for the sequencer run.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 20 ul of dH20 into any empty wells to ensure all 16 capillaries of the 3130 sequencer have liquid
Seal the plate with adhesive tape, cover with aluminum foil, and label appropriately

steps.title: Store or Sequence Samples
steps.instruction: Sequence the samples immediately for optimal results or store them.

substeps.instruction: Store at -20°C for long term (or up to two days)
